customManagers.description: Container image versions pinned as Ansible vars. Renovate's native managers cannot see these — the versions are consumed by templated compose and Dockerfile .j2 files, so the only place a version string actually exists is the group_vars file that declares it. Per this repo's rule that a var has exactly one declaration point, that is where this points; if a var's home ever moves, this pattern moves with it in the same change or it silently stops tracking.
